feedback: Valid and faithful. Format: proper ARM-FM artifact with a nonempty FINAL_STATES header (u4), which is declared in STATES and accepting for the task (at_exit completes it). All states referenced in transitions are declared, all propositions (at_exit, switch_toggled, holding_box) are environment predicates only, and every non-else transition has a matching reward line. Fidelity: the task is 'reach exit, and at some point toggle the switch and pick up the box'. The RM tracks two unordered sticky achievements (u1 = toggled, u2 = box held, u3 = both) plus terminal u4, which exactly captures 'at some point': drops, falls, and re-toggles cannot regress the state, which is correct here (no 'keep holding' or siren-silence requirement in this task, so no explicit regressions are needed). Irrelevant events (siren_ringing changes, box_fell, repeated toggles/pickups) are absorbed by per-state else self-loops with zero reward, so no double payment for repeated toggles or re-pickups. Reachability: u1 (toggle in u0), u2 (pickup in u0), u3 (either order: toggle then pickup, or pickup then toggle while carrying, which the environment permits) and u4 (at_exit from every non-final state) are all reachable; guards use !at_exit so exit transitions are mutually exclusive with progress transitions. Minor harmless redundancy: the direct (u0, switch_toggled & holding_box & !at_exit) -> u3 edge is unreachable in a single step (one action per step rules out simultaneous first toggle and first pickup), but it keeps progress totals consistent (0.2 = 0.1 + 0.1). Rewards: bounded at 1.2 total, progress rewards are small, paid at most once per milestone, terminal 1.0 paid once (u4 self-loop unrewarded), no negative or cycling rewards. The candidate is accepted.
